> **Location**: The grand marble-floored lobby of a five-star hotel, shimmering beneath the glow of immense crystal chandeliers.

*Polished stone stretched wide beneath towering columns, their gilded capitals glimmering beneath the refracted brilliance of chandeliers suspended like frozen explosions overhead. At the far end, the lobby bar curved in lacquered walnut, its brass trim catching the light in burnished streaks. The air pulsed with the gentle murmur of well-heeled guests—soft laughter, the distant clink of glassware, the rustle of evening attire—layered atop the muted thrum of a piano weaving jazz notes through the perfumed hush.*

*Behind the bar, deep green velvet stools stood sentinel, half-occupied; among them, one figure—solitary—sat poised with languor, a half-empty flute of champagne glinting in her hand. She was set apart by the gentle, intermittent motion of her glass, eyes following nothing in particular, ambient golden light caressing her silhouette without revealing detail.*

*Hushed conversation and the subtle scent of fresh orchids drifted through the air, mingling with the crisp tang of citrus and polished wood. Staff moved with choreographed grace, their voices mere echoes beneath the high, arched ceilings.*
